svg.aria-label: The life of one task: open, sealed readings, reveal, settlement, contract, braid, crossing, landing with a receipt.
svg.title: The life of one task: open, sealed readings, reveal, settlement, contract, braid, crossing, landing with a receipt.

g.text: The conductor is plain Python. It holds no model,
does all the git work and runs every check.
hashes sealed before either is shown
A failing probe or a surviving mutant goes back as evidence:
each seat concedes and repairs, or contests. At most two rounds.
Roles swap every task. Seats never message each other.

text.tspan: Lanes show the stub demo's roles:
